summary: "Baby I" is a 2013 song by American singer Ariana Grande, released as the second single from her debut studio album "Yours Truly". Written by Kenneth "Babyface" Edmonds, Antonio Dixon and Patrick "J. Que" Smith, and produced by Edmonds and Dixon, it was initially written with Beyoncé in mind, who rejected it. The pop and R&B track has a '90s-inspired uptempo beat and lyrically concerns being unable to fully express feelings for someone you love, and critics praised its throwback sound and Grande's vocals, which were compared to Mariah Carey.
one_line: "Baby I" is a 2013 pop and R&B single by Ariana Grande, the second from her debut album "Yours Truly".
key_facts: "Baby I" is a song recorded by American singer Ariana Grande for her debut studio album "Yours Truly" (2013).
"Baby I" was written by Kenneth "Babyface" Edmonds, Antonio Dixon and Patrick "J. Que" Smith.
"Baby I" was produced by Kenneth "Babyface" Edmonds and Antonio Dixon.
The song was released by Republic Records on July 22, 2013.
"Baby I" was released as the second single from the album "Yours Truly".
The song was initially written with the singer Beyoncé in mind, but Beyoncé rejected it.
"Baby I" is a pop and R&B song with drums, horns and a syncopated beat.
The song contains an uptempo '90s-inspired beat.
Lyrically, the song is about not being able to fully express your feelings towards someone you love.
The song was well received by music critics.
Some critics praised Ariana Grande's vocals by comparing them to those of singer Mariah Carey.
